## Validation

- [ ] This branch/PR contains one logical change and its own `CHANGELOG.md` update.
- [ ] The base/head and changed files match the declared scope.
- [ ] `npm ci` and `npm run check` pass.
- [ ] Browser tests pass for changes affecting the website or browser runtime.
- [ ] Public API, data contract and migration implications are documented.
- [ ] New/changed exercises have truthful review, provenance and media states.
- [ ] No private research, account exports or unlicensed media are included.
